name: Synopsys managed SaaS environment
description: A fully managed, web-based, ready-to-go design environment that can be setup within a day and provides access to all the infrastructure necessary for chip design work, including numerous compute and storage options, schedulers, UNIX desktop, and Synopsys EDA products installed.
features: Access to EDA, IP and compute infrastructure via secure, turnkey SaaS environment
Broad compute and storage options, with recommendations based on your workloads
FlexEDA licensing with pay-per-use and term-based Synopsys EDA licenses
Analytics dashboard to visualize your license usage and budget spend
License and budget governance on a per-user and per-project basis via self-serve portal
Seamless access to Synopsys IP
Pre-defined flows to jumpstart Analog, Digital, Verification and Photonics designs
Approved by top foundries for use with their design collateral and PDKs
The environment is enabled with Role Based Access Control (RBAC)

name: Bring Your Own Compute (BYOC)
description: A customer-managed environment, whether it is an on-prem data center or on the cloud such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, HPE, and Microsoft Azure.
features: Customers can bring in the cloud vendor of their choice to run Synopsys EDA tools, any third-party tools, foundry collateral, and PDKs
Customers do not need to manage license servers and keys for Synopsys EDA tools
Concurrent, seamless access to Synopsys EDA tools running on local license servers (customer's cloud environment) and the ones under pay-per-use access
Full control by customers of their cloud environment, with accessibility to run same flows, scripts, and binaries
Flexibility to run any third-party EDA tool on their cloud environment (customer's responsibility)
Foundry collateral and process development kits (PDKs) (customer managed)
Usage and analytics details on the consumption of cloud credits from a browser-based UI

name: Synopsys Cloud Hybrid Solution
description: Enables design teams to burst EDA workloads to the cloud securely, seamlessly, and quickly. A designer simply submits EDA jobs to their scheduler on-prem and the secure hybrid solution takes care of the rest, leveraging cloud compute capacity as needed.
features: No need to manually move data from on-prem to the cloud environment for jobs that run on the cloud
Data needed and generated on the cloud is synchronized automatically in real-time between the cloud and on-prem
Automatically splits the job between on-prem and cloud compute resources based on available capacity
Initially available for early customer access via a bring-your-own-cloud (BYOC) approach on Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services

name: FlexEDA Cloud Subscription License (CSL)
description: If you prefer to plan ahead, the CSL model provides the familiar fixed-number, term-based license access.
features: Instant purchase and activation of term-based licenses via a web portal
CSLs are of fixed term and quantity; paid upfront and cloud credits are deducted before use
For EDA products which are not cloud scalable

name: FlexEDA Pay-Per-Use (PPU) licensing
description: Grants unrestricted on-demand access to Synopsys' flagship applications at a per-minute rate. The metering algorithm monitors the jobs for the number and duration of licenses checked out and charges the user accordingly.
features: Pay-per-use access to unlimited licenses by-the-minute
Unlocks unlimited parallel processing
Cloud credits are deducted after actual use
No minimum spend thresholds or size limits on cloud engagement
Available for BYOC and SaaS deployments

name: Combine CSL and PPU
description: The combination of CSL and PPU via FlexEDA licensing allows the flexibility needed to cater to the changing EDA needs of a chip design project.
features: Analytics dashboard to visualize your license usage and budget spend
License governance on a per-user and per-project basis
licensing_model: Cloud subscription license combined with pay-per-use

name: Synopsys ZeBu Cloud
description: A hosted emulation solution that delivers flexible, turn-key, and secure emulation to accelerate software bring-up, performance validation, pre-silicon power analysis, and system validation from IP sub-systems to large multi-die SoCs.
features: New users can run emulation on ZeBu Cloud without the cost of purchasing and operating hardware
Users with on-premise ZeBu systems can use ZeBu Cloud to add capacity for specific phases or use case requirements during a project
Enables pre-silicon collaboration with customers in a secure emulation environment
Hosts emulation capacity in the Synopsys data center with high performance compute servers for the entire ZeBu flow
ISO 27001 and SOC2 Type 2 certified emulation cloud

name: Analog SaaS Cloud Instance
description: Provides a complete end-to-end design flow that leverages Synopsys' years of experience developing analog IP to maximize designer productivity. The flow is pre-configured in the virtual machine image, ready to be provisioned on-demand.
features: Schematic design, circuit simulation, layout creation, in-design analysis, extraction, verification, and signoff
Eliminates the need to maintain a CAD infrastructure
Global engineering teams can collaborate on the same schematic or layout or design
Not constrained by compute infrastructure or by licenses

name: Digital SaaS Cloud Instance
description: Provides automated flows for two primary tasks in a typical digital design: synthesis and RTL-to-signoff. All required EDA tools, third-party technologies, and pre-optimized compute virtual machine options are available with a few clicks in the browser window.
features: Pre-configured ready-to-use flows
Simplified and automated execution
Managed and flow-optimized compute
Pre-built flows remain fully customizable

name: Verification SaaS Cloud Instance
description: Incorporates a complete verification simulation flow including debug and analysis with pre-configured verification tasks. Allows companies to scale verification based on real-time demands without the need for purchasing more licenses.
features: No need for building out an extensive verification infrastructure
Pre-configured flows that can be implemented by the minute
Ready-to-use simulation and debug flows built with automation in mind

name: Photonic Cloud Instance
description: Provides a complete end-to-end design flow for photonic devices, systems, and integrated circuits, pre-configured in the virtual machine image and ready to be provisioned on demand.
features: Complete front-to-back electronic-photonic design flow in a browser-based SaaS environment
Ideal for start-ups and small/medium enterprises
OptoCompiler platform for photonic IC design

name: FlexEDA Playground
description: Provides a secure, pre-configured environment with sample designs and EDA tools, so you can start exploring immediately without setup or infrastructure overhead. 20 days of Playground access.
features: Analog, Digital, Verification, Photonics and TCAD design flows
A valid Synopsys Site ID and acceptance of the End User License Agreement and Playground Evaluation License Agreement are required
Access is subject to regional availability
